caption.linkedin:
Most web studios in our market quote "price on request". We publish a calculator instead — a range and a timeline in under a minute, no email required.

Why: the deterministic pricing engine runs in code, and the AI layer never touches the number. It explains and formats, then the engine's value overwrites whatever it produced.

It filters the pipeline in both directions. Clients who need a $200 site self-select out; clients who want to understand what they are buying start the conversation already informed.
